image_slots.scene_description: ঘি — object-only: কয়েকটি ঘি-এর বয়াম (NCTB p31 এর মতো), লেবেলে 'ঘি' লেখা বা লেবেল-মুক্ত; কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only; a few jars of ghee (matches NCTB p31); labels left blank or with the single word ঘি only — no baked paragraph text (script guard); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of three or four glass jars of pale ghee with coloured lids, grouped together, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no text on the labels, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: কীট — একটি কীট/শুঁয়োপোকা ডালের উপর (NCTB p31 এর মতো) — single animal spotlight।
image_slots.compliance_note: single caterpillar (কীট) on a twig (matches NCTB p31); body kept clear of lower third where stripe lands; no people; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single caterpillar resting on a twig, side profile, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.compliance_note: object-only scissors; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a pair of scissors, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: কাকি / কাকী — 'aunt' শব্দের ছবি: object-first প্রতীক (যেমন এক কাপ চা / চুড়ি) নাকি ঢেকে-রাখা নারী মূর্তি? এখানে object-first: এড়িয়ে গিয়ে একটি নিরপেক্ষ প্রতীক ব্যবহার করা কঠিন (কাকি = ব্যক্তি)। তাই: full-coverage পোশাকে (face+hands only) একজন প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক নারী, একক।
image_slots.compliance_note: কাকি/কাকী = aunt, adult female (C-05 + C-02). Single adult woman in full-coverage modest dress (face + hands only, hair/neck fully covered), standing/smiling gently; no other people, no men (no free-mixing). Stripe lands on plain area clear of face/hands; high-contrast line-art for B/W. Reviewer may instead drop কাকি/কাকী to word-only (no image) if a female figure is not desired on the page.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single adult woman in modest full-coverage clothing with a headscarf covering her hair and neck, only her face and hands visible, standing and smiling kindly. Plain white background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No other people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঝিঁঝিঁ — একটি ঝিঁঝিঁ পোকা (cricket) — single animal spotlight।
image_slots.compliance_note: single cricket insect (ঝিঁঝিঁ); kept clear of lower third where stripe lands; no people; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single cricket insect on a leaf, side profile, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছাগী — একটি ছাগী (she-goat) — single animal spotlight।
image_slots.compliance_note: single she-goat (ছাগী); body kept clear of lower third where stripe lands; no people; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single goat standing calmly, side profile, on a plain white background. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ই-কার/ঈ-কার লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — 'ি' ও 'ী' স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট।
image_slots.compliance_note: kar-tracing rows for ই-কার (ি) and ঈ-কার (ী) with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ২২ ই-কার ঈ-কার শিখি (🔒 স্থির; ি ও ী introduced). Same treatment as পাঠ ২১. Kept ঘি (ই-কার) + কীট (ঈ-কার); added decodable extras. LETTER AUDIT LIVE. পাঠ ২২ decodable inventory = vowels + consonants ক খ গ ঘ ঙ চ ছ জ ঝ ঞ ONLY (ট still NOT taught — comes পাঠ ২৩) + কার া ি ী; conjunct_whitelist=[] (empty, resolved) → no conjuncts. Added decodable-safe (user chose decodable): ই-কার row ঘি/কাঁচি/কাকি; ঈ-কার row কীট/কাকী/ঝিঁঝিঁ/ছাগী — all audit-pass. NOTE কীট uses ট which is NOT taught till পাঠ ২৩ — but কীট is NCTB-ORIGINAL (source=nctb, edited=false) → audit-exempt; NO school-added word uses ট. ছাগী confirmed ঈ-কার (long-ii), placed in ঈ row per user. কাকি(short-i, ই row) + কাকী(long-ii, ঈ row) both included = same 'aunt' word showing both কার forms (pedagogically apt). Rejected FAIL words (untaught consonants at পাঠ ২২): নদী/ঘানি/চিরুনি(ন), ছবি/চাবি(ব), গাভি(ভ), চাষী(ষ), গাড়ি/ঘুড়ি/ছড়ি(ড়), চিঠি(ঠ), জাহাজি(হ), খুকি(ু not taught till 27). IMAGES (replace): ঘি jars object-only (labels text-free, script-guard); কীট caterpillar stripe; কাঁচি object-only; ঝিঁঝিঁ cricket + ছাগী goat single-animal stripe; কাকি/কাকী aunt = single adult FEMALE full-coverage (face+hands only, C-02), no free-mixing, stripe — reviewer may drop to word-only if a female figure is unwanted. Tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. c_codes C-05/C-02/C-06/C-08. Ready to merge after পাঠ ২১.
